description.value: Pizza Heaven is the New Westminster outpost of the Vancouver Pizza Heaven chain, located near the Fraser River and, according to at least one customer review, situated inside a bar. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients, house-made dough, and a signature pan crust, with a broad menu that covers classic, vegan, gluten-free, and fusion styles. The location also offers catering for events.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 17m; stands at 17m; stands (8 spaces) at 80m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a 'Vancouver Pizza Heaven - New West' location at 81 6th Street, New Westminster, matching the OSM address, and the business is clearly active with an online menu and catering services. However, OSM lists the name as 'Pizza Heaven' (not 'Vancouver Pizza Heaven') and a phone number (+1-604-777-0669) that differs from the website's general contact (+1 604-568-6822). Dietary options (vegan, gluten-free, cauliflower crust) are explicitly confirmed on the website, and takeout/pickup is confirmed via the offers page; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pizza Heaven' but the business consistently uses 'Vancouver Pizza Heaven' across its entire website.
OSM phone +1-604-777-0669 does not match the website's listed contact number +1 604-568-6822; the OSM number may be a direct-location line not shown on the website.
A customer review states 'They are actually in the bar, so don't look for a pizza joint, it's inside the bar' — the physical setup of the New West location may be non-obvious to visitors.
OSM old_name tag is 'Ueno Senko', indicating a prior unrelated business at this address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible pizza restaurant with a confirmed New Westminster location listed on the business's own website. Useful to touring cyclists for a hot meal with vegan and GF options.

Takeout.detail: Offers page explicitly lists 'dine-in, takeout, and delivery orders'; some deals are marked 'PICKUP ONLY'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website front page explicitly lists 'Gluten-free • Cauliflower • Vegan • Fusion • Classic — Something for every taste and every diet.'
